title: Reference approach: Tensor Creator
answer: Implement tensor creator in a small isolated script. Required implementation evidence includes: torch.tensor, shape, dtype, ndim. Use a reproducible seed, report observed output, and explain relevant edge cases.
explanation: This exercise consolidates the topic from lesson 014. The list of required strings is only a minimal static signal; inspect numerical correctness, error handling, and test outcomes manually.
review_notes: Do not treat source-string grading as proof that numerical behavior is correct.
Run in a supported local environment or isolated runner.
Keep input data synthetic unless a dataset has an appropriate license and documented provenance.
